mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and temperatures at 42 degrees near City Hall. We are under a New Moon tonight, and with an overnight low of 42 degrees, you should prepare for rain heading into tomorrow.

The Mark Drive Reconstruction project is officially in Phase 2. Contractors are currently wrapping up concrete work for curbs, sidewalks, and driveways, with asphalt work weather-dependent and surface paving planned for next spring.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Tomorrow, you can enjoy Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or the Pizza and a Pitcher event at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. On Wednesday, check out Trivia Night at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds on eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in their parents being cited for permitting them to drive a prohibited motor vehicle.
Today's flavor was Chocolate Heath Crunch. Since the store is closed for the night, mark your calendars for tomorrow's flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist, when the doors open at 10:00 AM.
